hardShell.question: Does the cover fit hard-shell suitcases?
hardShell.answer: Yes! Our covers are specifically designed for hard-shell suitcases. The stretchy spandex fabric with elastic bottom ensures a snug, secure fit on hard-shell luggage.

dualZippers.question: What are the dual zipper openings for?
dualZippers.answer: Our covers feature dual zipper openings at the top for easy access to both the top carry handle and the telescopic handle. This allows you to use your suitcase normally without removing the cover.

washCover.question: Can I wash the luggage cover?
washCover.answer: Yes, all our covers are machine washable at 30°C (86°F). Use a gentle cycle with similar colors. Do not tumble dry, iron, or bleach. Air dry for best results.

sizeCover.question: How do I choose the right size cover?
sizeCover.answer:
Simply measure your suitcase height from the floor to the top (excluding wheels).

S = 18-21 inches (45-53cm)
M = 22-25 inches (55-63cm)
L = 26-28 inches (65-70cm)
XL = 29-32 inches (72-81cm)

Check our detailed Size Guide for more information →

hardShell.question: Does the cover fit hard-shell suitcases?
hardShell.answer: Yes! Our covers are specifically designed for hard-shell suitcases. The stretchy spandex fabric with elastic bottom ensures a snug, secure fit on hard-shell luggage.

dualZippers.question: What are the dual zipper openings for?
dualZippers.answer: Our covers feature dual zipper openings at the top for easy access to both the top carry handle and the telescopic handle. This allows you to use your suitcase normally without removing the cover.

washCover.question: Can I wash the luggage cover?
washCover.answer: Yes, all our covers are machine washable at 30°C (86°F). Use a gentle cycle with similar colors. Do not tumble dry, iron, or bleach. Air dry for best results.

security.question: Will airport security ask me to remove the cover?
security.answer: In most cases, no. The cover is thin and doesn't obstruct X-ray scanning. However, security officers reserve the right to ask for removal if they need to inspect the contents more closely.

handles.question: Do I still have access to handles and wheels?
handles.answer: Absolutely! Our covers are designed with openings for top and side handles, and the wheels remain completely free so you can roll your suitcase normally.

rfid.question: What is RFID protection?
rfid.answer: RFID (Radio-Frequency Identification) protection blocks unauthorized wireless scanning of your cards and passport. This prevents electronic pickpocketing in crowded places like airports and tourist areas.

cards.question: How many cards can the wallet hold?
cards.answer: Depending on the model, our wallets hold between 3-6 credit cards, plus your passport, boarding passes, cash, and even a SIM card. Check individual product descriptions for exact capacity.

leather.question: Is the leather genuine?
leather.answer: Yes, all our passport wallets use full-grain genuine leather that develops a beautiful patina over time. We source high-quality leather that is both durable and elegant.

pocket.question: Will the wallet fit in my pocket?
pocket.answer: Our wallets are designed to be compact yet functional. They fit comfortably in most jacket pockets, handbags, and carry-on bags while holding all your essential travel documents.

shipping.question: Where do you ship to?
shipping.answer: We currently ship across Egypt only. We are working on expanding to other countries soon. All orders are delivered to all Egyptian governorates.

shippingTime.question: How long does shipping take?
shippingTime.answer: Egypt: 1-2 business days to all governorates. Express delivery available for Cairo and Giza.

track.question: How can I track my order?
track.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking number. You can also track your order through your account on our website or contact us for assistance.

freeShip.question: Do you offer free shipping?
freeShip.answer: Yes! We offer free standard shipping on all orders over EGP 1000 within Egypt. For orders below this amount, shipping is a flat rate of EGP 75.

returnPolicy.question: What is your return policy?
returnPolicy.answer: We offer a 30-day return policy for unused items in original packaging. We also provide 6 months warranty against manufacturing defects. If you're not satisfied with your purchase, contact us to initiate a return. Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive the item.

exchange.question: Do you offer exchanges?
exchange.answer: Yes, we offer free size exchanges within 30 days. If your cover doesn't fit, contact us and we'll send you the correct size with free return shipping for the original item.
